tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ rin chen sna bdun 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad bzhugs so// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ lha dbang gsung gi rnga chen gyis bskul nas// lha yi bzo bo las bskrun thams cad pas// lha rdzas las bgyis rtsibs stong rab mnyam ldan// lha lam yangs par thogs pa med 'gro ba// sa skyong dpung gi yan lag tshogs bcas kun// ji tsam 'dod pa'i yul la dbang byed 'di// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul lags na// 'gro kun 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpal 'dzin shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod 'os zur brgyad pa// rgyal po'i yid la ci bsam ster byed cing*// rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong la gegs med par// rgyal mdzad de la lan gcig gsol bas kyang*// yangs pa'i mnga' 'bangs mtsho bzhin gang ba dang*// phun tshogs ji snyed bsdud pa'i nor bu 'di// thub dbang sras dang= /'gro kun chos dang srid kyi 'byor thob shog /gzugs mdzes ngag snyan tsandan dri bsrung can// sbrang rtsi'i ro ster reg pas nyon mongs dang*// yid kyi gdung ba ji snyed 'phrog byed pa// rgyal po la 'dud kun la glo ba nye// nang gshin mdzes sdug dpa' ba'i bu mang btsa'// lha dbang yid rab 'dzin pa'i btsun mo 'di// thub dbang sras dang= /'gro kun zag med bde bas 'tsho byed shog /rang srid skyong ba'i nor gyi 'du 'god dang*// gzhan sde gnon pa'i dpung gi 'dor len dang*// tshar gcad rjes 'dzin shes pa'i dpa' mdzangs dang*// kun la snyoms pa'i rnam dpyod drang po yis// chos dang srid kyi gzhung lugs ji bzhin du// mang 'bangs tshul bzhin skyong ba'i blon po 'di// thub dbang sras dang= /'gro kun dge ba'i grogs kyis 'tsho bar shog /sred med stobs 'dzin pha rol dpung las rgyal// sred pas ma bcings dul ba'i ngang tshul can// sred pa'i chang gis myos pa'i yul gru kun// sred las grol ba'i goms stabs kyis mnan te// sa yi brgya byin nye dbang dang bcas pa// mthon po'i gnas su 'degs pa'i glang chen 'di// thub dbang sras dang=

/'gro kun lha min g.yul las rgyal byed shog /brgya byin yid kyis sprul pa'i skye mched can// brgya phrag 'khor gyis bskor bzhin mkha' la yang*// brgya lam bzhin du brgyug la thogs med pas// brgya phrag gling rnams nyin res 'khor ba la// thogs med 'dod pa'i phyogs su rtag par rgyu// rmongs pa'i skabs bral cang shes kha lo pa// thub dbang la 'bul dge bas 'gro ba kun// brtson 'grus rta brgya'i khri la 'khod par shog /gsal mdzangs bung bas dbyibs legs bcud ldan pa'i// 'dab brgya'i tshal la nam yang mi gnod par// sbrang rtsi blangs nas kun dga'i dpal bskyed ltar// 'bangs kyi bde skyid nam yang mi len par// dpya dang lo ma'i thabs kyis rgyal po yi// bang mdzod 'gengs mkhas khyim bdag rin chen 'di// thub dbang la 'bul dge bas 'gro ba kun// chos dang srid kyi bang mdzod khengs par shog /'khor lo 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal byed dang*// nor bu nor gyi phung po stsol mkhas dang*// btsun mo btsun pa'i mchog gyur dul ba 'di// thub dbang thub pa'i rgyal srid rgyas phyir 'bul// blon po blon chen mang pos 'dud pa dang*// glang chen glang po stong gi stobs can dang*// rta mchog rta brgya'i dbus na mgrin mtho ba// kun mkhyen kun las 'phags pa'i don du 'bul// 'bangs la 'bangs kyi bde skyid kun ster zhing*// rgyal la rgyal po'i bzhed don kun 'byor ba'i// khyim bdag khyim gyi 'byor pa kun tshang 'di// rgyal dbang rgyal srid skyong ba'i don du 'bul// //de nas nye ba'i rin po che rnam pa bdun 'bul ba'i tshig ni/ ral gri rin chen rgyal po'i dgra phyogs su// ma bskul bzhin du song nas ma btab kyang*// rang la 'dud cing rtsod pa kun sel ba'i// nye ba'i rin chen 'di yang rgyal la 'bul// pags pa rin chen mi kha'i char skyob cing*// nang nas ming gshin rlung gis mi bskyod par// phyi nang kun gyi nyer 'tshe sel byed pa'i// nye ba'i rin chen 'di=

/khang pa rin chen dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa// chos dang srid kyi dgos pa kun 'char zhing*// 'jig rten skyong ba rnam bzhis rtag srung ba// nye ba'i rin chen= /gos bzang rin chen 'jam 'khril dri zhim pa// reg pas bde ster tsha grang skyon ma gos// rtag tu me dang mtshon gyi gnod bral ba// nye ba'i rin chen= /skyed tshal rin chen 'dod yon tshogs bkra zhing*// dga' ba'i glu dbyangs snyan pa'i dar dir can// mi bsrun skye bo'i gtam gyi skabs bral ba// nye ba'i rin chen= /stan 'jam rin chen yid la dga' ba spel// gang la 'dug pas nyon mongs mi skye zhing*// rtag tu blo gsal yid gzhung byed 'gyur ba'i// nye ba'i rin chen= /mchil lh+wam rin chen chu la mi 'bying zhing*// nyes pa'i rdul dang phrag dog tsher ma bsrung*// yud tsam gyis kyang dpag tshad brgyar bgrod pa'i// mchil lh+wam rin chen= /lha rdzas rdo rje ind+ra nī la dang*// rdo yi snying po margad anda rnyil// gser dngul mu tig rin chen bai ḍūryā// nye ba'i rin chen= /de ltar phul bas ma pham skye bo yi// 'jug ngogs yid 'ong gser gyi khang bzangs 'dir// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal bzung nas// chos kyi rgyal srid tshul bzhin skyong bar shog /de las byung ba'i rnam dkar ci mchis pas// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa// byang chub yan lag bdun gyi dpal thob nas// chos kyi rgyal po'i khri la 'dug gyur cig /ces mdo sde bzhag pa las gsungs pa'i rin po che sna bdun dang*/ nye ba'i rin po che bdun 'bul ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa 'di ni/ sa skyong bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po'i gsung gis nye bar bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ gser 'phyang gi lo sa ga'i nya la gser mdog can gyi dben gnas dam pa nas phul ba'o// //maṅga laṃ bha wantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/
